## Adaptation notes
# Kept: key G minor, the i - iv - V - i skeleton of the source verse, the dominant pull at each phrase end
# Changed: triads Gm / Cm / D7 -> seventh chords Gm7 / Cm7 / D7 (bossa harmony colour)
# Changed: second verse phrase puts ii7b5 in bar 2 (ii - V - i approach)
# Changed: Chorus -> iv7 - bVII7 - bIIImaj7 - V7 (modal interchange, no cadence on i until the next pass)
# Risks: the chorus never lands on i, so the song relies on the vocal and bass to feel resolved
